children: Two addresses recently sold about 1.21 million HYPE, earning a combined profit of more than $26.5 million. According to Foresight News, Lookonchain monitored the transactions: an address beginning with 0x2685 sold 912,383 HYPE 6 hours ago, making more than $10 million after buying the tokens one month ago. An address beginning with 0x648F sold 296,705 HYPE 8 hours ago, earning $16.5 million after purchasing the tokens 11 months ago.

title: Two Addresses Sell About 1.21 Million HYPE, Make More Than $26.5 Million
